hypotheses.scope: Nominal case, seed 17, frozen offline_reach_hold_v1 acceptance, frozen timing/tolerances and stable controller.gvs_normpc@7.0.0; current campaign feedback only.
hypotheses.statement: Outcome 0 (execution 054cb6d5) is a fresh, valid, jointly accepted nominal point (F414, F430, F460, F454) that is strictly dominated by the retained incumbent on every sampled physical metric: terminal_error_m 0.003195 m (F415), holding_max_error_m 0.003323 m (F360) and holding_max_speed_m_s 0.013737 m/s (F350) versus the incumbent's recorded 0.002698 m, 0.002730 m and 0.012750 m/s. Outcome 1 (execution dfb3b398) is a valid_failure (F501, F461, F325) whose sole failing component is sampled holding speed 0.054581 m/s (F482, F405); it changes more than one path, so it is confounded and says nothing about the unchanged incumbent.
hypotheses.uncertainty: Identity-based incumbent comparison is classified unavailable because configuration identities differ, so the comparison above is descriptive against recorded incumbent metrics; one execution per configuration; no causal attribution and no continuous-time guarantee.

hypotheses.scope: Executed in-scope evidence only; no population, seed-18, unseen-case, three-group or global-optimum claim.
hypotheses.statement: No executed configuration in this scope is yet established as jointly accepted with all three sampled physical metrics non-worsening relative to the retained incumbent; tested deviations give dominated passes (F415/F360/F350) or holding-speed failures (F482). The granted structural region is therefore the highest-information affordable direction: near_section_scale has been probed upward (1.00 dominated pass, 1.05 confounded failure), while design/far_section_scale, components/near/length_m, components/far/length_m and both material scenarios remain untested on nominal.
hypotheses.uncertainty: Untested points may be non-worsening, dominated or failing; the granted eight-variable catalog is not exhausted and local evidence cannot guarantee nonlinear reach, braking or perturbation robustness.

hypotheses.scope: Recorded campaign control-weight points at the retained structure; descriptive association only.
hypotheses.statement: Sampled holding speed at the frozen structure is not monotone in the frozen control tip-speed weights: higher holding penalties recorded higher sampled holding speed, and the one control-weight change that lowered holding speed did so while enlarging terminal and holding position error. Control-only adaptation therefore currently yields only trade-offs or failures, which motivates an isolated structural probe at frozen weights.
hypotheses.uncertainty: Single executions, confounded representation differences between initializer records, and only two weight values per axis executed; no monotonicity, causality or continuous-time claim is made.
